source_values.extracted: pulled from the case documents by extraction
source_values.drafted: proposed by the system or written by the lawyer; always reviewed and confirmed by the lawyer
source_values.case_intake: entered when the case is created or the report is issued
source_values.search_office: taken from the Sub-Registrar / IGR search
source_values.profile: the advocate's profile (name, place of signing)

review_levels.must_confirm: Legal judgement (opinion, marketability, adverse or critical remarks, tenure, SARFAESI enforceability, claims, permissions). Never auto-confirmed: a lawyer must explicitly confirm or write the value. No positive wording is drafted while the case has open red flags.
review_levels.glance: Factual checklist answer, letterhead, party or search detail that can be pre-filled from the extracted documents and shown for a quick lawyer check.

rules: A must_confirm field is never auto-confirmed: a lawyer must explicitly confirm or write its value.
The system must not draft "clear and marketable", "no adverse entry", "enforceable" or similar favourable wording for a must_confirm field while the case has open red flags.
A glance field may be pre-filled from extracted documents but is still shown to the lawyer for a quick check before the report is issued.
An unset field renders as empty text; no conclusion text is hard-coded in the template.

notes: documents_post_disbursement: the original had no item paragraphs; one loop block was added.
The mutation question in the original has no answer line, so no field exists for it.
open_questions: CONFIRM WITH THE LAWYER: mapping of the two pre-disbursement lists. 'PRE DISBURSEMENT-' (3 items in the source) -> documents_initial_pre_disbursement; 'Prior to Disbursement' (7 items) -> documents_pre_disbursement.

fields.name: adverse_remarks
fields.description: Adverse remarks on title; no default

fields.name: advocate_name
fields.description: Advocate name printed in the signature / searcher line (without the 'Adv.' prefix, which stays in the template)

fields.name: bank_branch
fields.description: Bank branch or city the report is addressed to

fields.name: mortgage_creatable
fields.description: Whether the mortgage can be created (e.g. Yes)

fields.name: mortgage_type
fields.description: Type of mortgage to be created (printed in headings; Tata prints it upper-case)

fields.name: mortgagor_name
fields.description: Mortgagor / owner name(s) as they should read in the opinion

fields.name: opinion_conclusion
fields.description: Remainder of the opinion after the ownership clause: title, mortgage ability, enforceability, any conditions

fields.name: property_description
fields.description: Full property description paragraph, including boundaries if any

fields.name: property_tax_payment_status
fields.description: Confirmation of property tax payment in current owner's name

fields.name: property_tenure
fields.description: Freehold/leasehold; also drives the opinion wording (only Freehold and Leasehold produce an ownership clause)

fields.name: search_conclusion
fields.description: Conclusion of the encumbrance search (e.g. whether any adverse entry was found)

loops.name: chain_steps
loops.description: Chain-of-title narration, one paragraph per step

loops.name: deviations
loops.description: Deviations from the bank guidelines; empty list = none recorded

loops.name: documents_initial_pre_disbursement
loops.description: Documents under 'PRE DISBURSEMENT-' (Kotak) - mapping to be confirmed with the lawyer

loops.name: documents_post_disbursement
loops.description: Documents post-disbursement; NONE label prints when empty

loops.name: documents_pre_disbursement
loops.description: Documents under 'Prior to Disbursement' (Kotak) - mapping to be confirmed with the lawyer

loops.name: documents_verified
loops.description: Documents verified, one full description each
